prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the supplied paint_mask_guide.png, the first input and authoritative edit target. The second image design_reference.png supplies design/material detail; the third icon_x8.png supplies original colours only (magenta is background).
Output ONE transparent RGBA PNG at 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 canvas. Preserve the entire guide's exact composition, silhouettes, positions, sizes, orientations and openings. Three columns by FOUR rows of square cells. Rows 1-2 contain five orthographic views FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Rows 3-4 repeat those exact five views for material masks. Do not rearrange views based on their names; trace the provided guide exactly. Small edge-on heads must stay edge-on and the complete central head-and-handle silhouettes must stay identical. Paint only existing grey objects, do not redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour faithfully matching original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Exceptionally massive bright-silver rectangular block head with deep beveled geometric panels, thick silver socket, very long thin plain reddish-brown wooden handle. Match visible three-lobed head structure from references within exact guide geometry. Facets and recessed geometric panels follow design reference, scaled into each view. Subtle fine silver and wood surface detail, no illumination baked into base colour. No cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glows, outlines or ground.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five exact silhouettes, entirely filled with FLAT PURE colours, no texture, shading, outlines or internal antialiased colour blends. Every silver/metal head and socket pixel pure red #FF0000; every wood handle pixel pure yellow #FFFF00. If any other materials are present: leather/fur pure green #00FF00, cloth/hair pure blue #0000FF, gemstones/glass/enamel pure black #000000. Material boundaries match the painted views above precisely. No grey/white mask regions.
All outside-silhouette pixels genuinely transparent, including every gap and opening. Row 2 column 3 and row 4 column 3 completely empty/transparent. No text, labels, borders, checkerboard, background or extra objects. Harmless static decorative fantasy prop texture sheet.
CORRECTIVE GENERATION: The previous attempt introduced scattered red/yellow pixels and halos beyond object boundaries, violating the silhouettes. Strictly preserve the first input guide's alpha silhouettes. Absolutely no stray pixels or paint anywhere outside those ten objects. Clean continuous edges, transparent empty space. Lower-half mask colours must be completely uniform pure red and yellow, with no shading or texture. Upper paint must not have red/yellow edge contamination. Match original guide boundaries exactly.
